notes.title: Update Notes for 09AUG24
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

===

Major Changes:
 - Removed bhop benefit before the timer has started
    -When the timer starts your speed will be reduced to default max speed. Bhopping or coyote jump boosts will continue to give you speed after the timer has begun.

Minor Addition:
 - Added santa hat armor
 - Added Bishflop slime skin

===

Thank you everyone for your feedback and although the removing the pre-timer boosts will change the meta in a few of the challenge levels, it will allow more fair and consistent speed running as well as more freedom in future challenge level creation.

Thank you so much and I hope to see you next Friday for Challenge level C-7!

notes.title: 14APR24 Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

===

Major Changes
[list]
[*] Added Demo Launch Option
[*] Change right side space to be less punishing in slopes
[*] Added Exclusive Fullscreen option in menu settings
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Time on leaderboards now displays up to 999 hours
[*] Fix stuttering Issues 
    - Added Exclusive Fullscreen which is preferred by windows
    - Physics engine now runs on a separate cpu thread
    - Changed V-sync to limit frame rate to users monitor refresh rate
[/list]
